title: process-flow
description: Sequential step-by-step process composition. Each step displays a numbered circle, step name, and body text in a content card. Steps animate in sequence with circle activation and panel crossfades. Suitable for any 2–8 step process, workflow, or checklist.

title.description: Main title displayed at the top of the composition

subtitle.description: Subtitle paragraph below the title (2–3 lines recommended)
subtitle.default: Like any negotiation, it is a process — back and forth, ironing out and amending.

steps.description: JSON-encoded array of step objects. Each: { label (string, e.g. '1'), name (string), body (string) }. Supports 2–8 steps.

activeStep.description: Zero-based index of the step shown at composition start

primaryColor.description: Active circle colour, heading colour, and connector fill. Should match the base plate colour.

basePlateImage.description: Filename of the ACS v2 base plate background PNG.

bgColor.description: Page background colour. Use ACS canvas #f5f2ea.

durationPerStep.description: Seconds each step is displayed. Total = steps.length × durationPerStep + 1s hold.
